dialogs.content: #Hmm? Is that you, {NICKNAME}, Paimon? Ah, wonderful, excellent timing! I was just about to head to the Adventurers' Guild to post a commission!
#Well, well, well! A commission, coming right to us? Guess we're eating good tonight, {NICKNAME}!
Ahem... Paimon...
Oh, uh, that's right. As famed adventurers, we've got some standards when it comes to our fees...
Don't you worry about that! As long as you manage the various experimental modules as you did before, you'll be well compensated — I guarantee it!
B—Before? Wait, have we met?
*sigh* Have you forgotten me again? It's me, Hosseini, a researcher from Sumeru. We've worked together a bunch of times already, you know...?
S—Sorry, we just, uh...
I hope you recall the Energy Amplifier, at least?
Wait, you're Amplifier Man, aren't you?
...Oh, right! It's you! You're the one from The Chasm!
You're a lot more cheerful than when we saw you last... No wonder we didn't recognize you.
Hehe, is that so? I guess I'm just that happy, then — I haven't been this lucky in a long while.
Huh. What happened? C'mon, tell us!
Well, it's a long story. After we parted last time, I returned straight to the Akademiya and proposed the idea of an artificial Energy Amplifier based on the data we collected.
At first, my mentor seemed very excited by the proposal. Gave it the "highest praise" right on the spot, in fact. And then...
Then...?
He booted me out of Sumeru to make me run errands for him in Fontaine.
Wait, what? Why? Didn't he praise you?
Oh, he did praise me! For having the gall to submit a fantasy novel as a project proposal, I mean.
Err, no matter how you spin it, that's definitely not praise...
Indeed. I, too, found myself trapped in a pit of despair for some time. However, I had the good fortune of encountering some fine partners and investors here — they took up my project immediately.
With their assistance, I've successfully integrated my previous research with Fontainian techniques to create an artificial Energy Amplifier — the "Hosseini Amplifier."
As long as it passes the tests as my calculations predict it should, forget the trials of the God of Wisdom — I may yet even become a Sage.
Haven't even graduated yet, have we?
Ahem! No need to fuss over meaningless confounding variables like that. That's just a tiny twist on the road to success.
The most important thing now is to experimentally verify the actual performance of my Amplifier. That's why I need volunteers to test it within Domains.
#Well, then, {NICKNAME}, would you like to volunteer to test my Hosseini Amplifier?
Simply put, you need me to use it while I beat up baddies.
Yes, precisely. I have nothing but faith in your capabilities, but the current Amplifier design isn't quite up to mark, so do be careful.
Alright. Leave it to me!
#Now, {NICKNAME}, I have nothing but faith in your capabilities, but the current Amplifier design isn't quite up to mark, so do be careful.
Nothing comes to mind there either...
What about "Amplifier Man," then? Surely that rings a bell!
